verdict.rationale: Deploying Docker containers is a fair question for a deployment platform like Netlify, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions Docker or container image deployment. The documented deploy paths are Git push, the CLI, folder drag-and-drop, and serverless functions, and one community comment says Netlify users only get JS/TS/Go language support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy applications packaged as Docker containers
